title: Thermal equilibrium from finite population counting
description:
Complete finite counting forces a unique half-share binary equilibrium and a unique dyadic multinomial maximum at fixed population and throw.

Maria Smith derives exact positive temperature, the full binomial census, the generated dyadic ladder, its strict multinomial maximum for every finite level count, complementary response and the deterministic four-record orbit in Smithian Fold Theory. The paper gives the complete integer-factor argument, exhaustive enumeration proofs and operation-level survivor records.

The separately sealed acoustic and Johnson-noise thermometry comparisons both contain the exact SI Boltzmann carrier within their full registered uncertainty intervals. Includes 512 candidate decisions, 295 distinct empty-axiom audited Lean declarations, pinned V3/V4 sources, primary snapshots and portable exact reproduction.

Read the complete paper (PDF). Full source and evidence archive included.
